name: floodguard-ai
description: IoT + AI/ML + MERN prototype for heavy-rainfall early warning and flood-risk monitoring (ESP32 + HC-SR04). Prototype / demo only. Not a replacement for official flood warning systems. Zones, shelters and simulated nodes are SAMPLE data. The ML model is trained on SYNTHETIC data.

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client" "python -m uvicorn app:app --app-dir ml-service --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000"
